    def in_bounds(nx, ny):

    foes = []
    for cell in visible:

        if isinstance(cell, dict):
            t = cell.get("type")
            px = cell.get("x")
            py = cell.get("y")
            if t == "resource" and px is not None and py is not None:
                resources.append((px, py))

    if resources:

        if isinstance(rx, int) and isinstance(ry, int):
            tx, ty = rx, ry
            dx = 0 if tx == x else (1 if tx > x else -1)
            dy = 0 if ty == y else (1 if ty > y else -1)
        else:
            dx = 0; dy = 0
        nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
        if in_bounds(nx, ny):

    if grid_h is not None and grid_w is not None:
        cx, cy = (grid_h // 2, grid_w // 2)
        dx = 0 if cx == x else (1 if cx > x else -1)
        dy = 0 if cy == y else (1 if cy > y else -1)
        if (dx != 0 or dy != 0) and in_bounds(x + dx, y + dy):
